text: Hello. I'm minding my nephew overnight while my sister's away, he's 10 months old. Just wanted some advice really, nothing dramatic. He's teething quite badly at the moment. Dribbling constantly, soaked through two bibs since teatime, and he's chewing on anything he can get his hands on, the remote, my fingers, the edge of the cot. One cheek has gone quite red, the left side, which my sister did say happens when a tooth's on its way. He's a bit grizzly with it, as you'd expect. I'll mention it because I know people ask: no fits, no shaking or jerking or anything like that, he's just uncomfortable. I've got a teething ring in the fridge and gave him that for a bit. Mainly I wanted to know if there's anything else you'd suggest for tonight to help him settle, or anything I should keep an eye out for. Thanks very much.
